description: Source code for classes and methods handling control actions for RAN resource management, specifically for slice-level PRB quota control in a 5G network, including parsing RAN parameters, executing control actions, and converting requests/responses.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_du_executor_base
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for control action executors, including getting action ID, name, and control action definition, and handling control failure responses.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_2_6_du_executor
classes.description: Derived class implementing specific control action (ID 6) for slice-level PRB quota management, including parsing parameters, executing control actions, and converting requests/responses.

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the control action definition with parameters.

methods.name: return_ctrl_failure
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous failure response for control requests.

methods.name: parse_action_ran_parameter_value
methods.description: Parses individual RAN parameter values based on parameter ID and updates control configuration accordingly.

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if the control request is supported based on available parameters.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes the control action, including validation, logging, and invoking configuration routines.

methods.name: convert_to_du_config_request
methods.description: Converts a control request into a DU MAC scheduler control configuration.

methods.name: convert_to_e2sm_response
methods.description: Converts DU configuration response into an E2SM control response.
